summary: Iteration 53 — Frontend validation of the CO-OWNER (owner→owner promote/demote) flow on People → Team panel (Team.js). All 5 review flows PASS + guardrail verified empirically. (A) Add-Member dialog as OWNER: member-role-select options = ['sales','production','finance','owner'] — the new 'owner' option is present. Selecting owner hides [data-testid=permission-list] and renders [data-testid=owner-access-note] ('Full company access — Owners can open and manage everything…'). Switching back to a non-owner role restores the perm grid and removes the note. (B) PROMOTE FLOW: created throwaway member testco1784280801@sharma.com (sales), clicked edit-access-<id>, changed role to Owner, saved → window.confirm fired with 'This makes them a co-owner with FULL control…' (accepted). Row's role chip flipped to red 'owner'. Original owner (Rajesh) still shows 'owner' chip → CO-OWNERS state confirmed. (C) CO-OWNER LOGIN: signed out and signed back in as the promoted user. Top-bar shows OWNER role chip; sidebar shows Operating Score button; clicking it navigates to /operating-score (owner-only route, no 403). /auth/me returns role=owner with all 13 perms. Add-Member button visible on People→Team, and role dropdown INCLUDES 'owner' (co-owner can grant Owner). (D) DEMOTE FLOW: back as primary owner, edited co-owner and switched role sales → save → window.confirm 'Remove Owner access…At least one owner must remain.' (accepted) → PATCH 200, chip flipped back to blue 'sales', perm grid re-appeared. Note: the Access button was correctly visible on the co-owner row for the acting owner user (line 257 condition: canManageTeam && (u.role !== 'owner' || isOwner)). (E) LAST-OWNER SAFEGUARD: with only Rajesh as owner, attempted to demote Rajesh via edit → owner→sales → save. window.confirm fired and was accepted. Backend responded 400 (verified in network tab). Toast rendered: 'Cannot demote the last owner — assign another owner first' — Rajesh's chip stayed 'owner' after the attempt. (G) NON-OWNER GUARDRAIL: temporarily granted Priya (sales) the [people, team_manage] perms, signed in as her. Add-Member button visible, but member-role-select options = ['sales','production','finance'] — 'owner' option is HIDDEN. Same for the edit-access dialog on another member. Perms reverted afterwards. All 17 assertions PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: Team.js line 51 — MemberDialog receives `isOwner` prop but never reads it inside the component body; the Owner option is instead injected via the roleOptions array passed from TeamPanel (line 204). The prop is dead code — either remove it or use it inside setRole()/save() as a redundant defensive check.

Team.js line 257 — the condition `canManageTeam && (u.role !== 'owner' || isOwner)` correctly gates the Access edit button for owner rows. However, this leaks a subtle UX: a non-owner with team_manage sees NO edit button on any owner member, but the Add flow could STILL let them create a duplicate 'owner' — mitigated by roleOptions gating (line 204), which is correct. Consider adding an explicit backend-mirror check in the save() path so if roleOptions is tampered with client-side (React DevTools), the client shows a nicer error than raw 403.

Team.js line 82-83 — the demoting-owner confirm text says 'At least one owner must remain' but the confirm is fired even when demoting the LAST owner (E flow). Users may click OK expecting success and then see the toast — arguably fine but confusing. Consider pre-checking `members.filter(m=>m.role==='owner').length > 1` client-side and either hide the Owner→other option or short-circuit with a toast before the confirm. Would eliminate a wasted round-trip.

Team.js line 137 uses a bare <select> for role. Because a member with 'Owner' + a normal role selected (owner-note visible), the underlying dropdown still shows the 'Owner' pre-existing selection when reopened even if you never intended to promote — no regression, but adding an italic hint under the note like 'Save to grant Owner access' would set expectation.

Frontend hydration warning (unrelated to this feature): '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — comes from Emergent Visual Editor injecting a <span> inside the Reporting Manager <option> at Team.js:145. Pre-existing since iter50 and unchanged; not caused by the co-owner feature. Just noting so it's not misattributed.
Team.js line 51 MemberDialog `isOwner` unused prop — dead code. Minor cleanup: remove or actually consume.

Team.js line 78 `save` function is 33 lines with nested confirm dialogs, add/edit branches, invite-token side effect. Consider extracting to `handlePromote`, `handleDemote`, `handleCreate` for testability. Currently ok but pushing 700-line threshold.

The demote-confirm and promote-confirm strings are hardcoded — no i18n. Fine for MVP but flag for future when a Tamil user creates a co-owner (Tanglish is already supported for capture — consistency would suggest localizing these prompts).
